b: Home / Search Forum Recap / Daily Search Forum Recap: November 12, 2026
Here is a recap of what happened in the search forums today, through the eyes of the Search Engine Roundtable and other search forums on the web.

Google Ads has a new invalid traffic overview card to show you how much you got back for fake traffic. Google is testing placing source icons in AI Overviews at the bottom. Google is expanding definition queries to show the full AI Overview by default. Google posted on how to move to a CDN without impacting Google. Google Ads disallows impersonating public figures with AI even with disclosure. Google Ads disallows targeting users based on prohibited categories. Google Ads has a found on site and more pages label. Google Ads Editor version 2.14 is out and Google Ads API 26.2 is out. Google Ads has a new data strength uplift metric. Bing is touting a way to turn off AI responses in search, but why isn't it a search setting?

Google Ads New Invalid Traffic (IVT) Overview Card
Google Ads announced a new Invalid Traffic (IVT) overview card within Google Search. Google's Keerat Sharma wrote, "We’re rolling out the Invalid Traffic Overview Card in Google Ads to give advertisers front-end transparency into how we protect their campaigns."

Google Placing Source Icons At Bottom Of AI Overviews
Google is testing moving the citations or sources icons to the very bottom of the AI Overviews. Previously, these icons appeared at the top of the AI Overview; now Google is testing placing them at the bottom, which may make it even harder to find the sources of the answers Google generates in these AI Overviews and could reduce clicks to your site even more.

Google Ads API Version 26.2 Now Out Available
Google Ads has just released a minor update to its Google Ads API - version 26.2. This update touches on assets, campaigns, reporting, and more general updates.

Google Search AI Overview Definitions Expanded By Default
Google is expanding the AI Overviews for definitions by default, where you no longer have to click on "Show more" to see the full version of the AI Overview. This is similar to when Google confirmed it dynamically expands some AI Overviews based on the query, but now Google is doing this for all definition searches.

Google: How Moving to a CDN Can Accidentally Overwhelm Your Website
Gary Illyes and Chery Prommawin released the final video in the Non-Canonical Cabinet series, this one is on CDNs, content delivery networks. They discuss why migrating a website to a CDN can suddenly increase Googlebot crawling activity, why this may overload your origin server, and how to avoid accidentally blocking Google's crawlers.

Google Ads Disallows Impersonate Public Figures With AI Even If Disclosed
Google Ads clarified in its unacceptable Business Practices policy that impersonating public figures using AI isn’t allowed, even if they disclose that they were generated or edited using AI.

Google Ads Disallows Targeting Users Based On Prohibited Content Interests
Google Ads has added a single line to the Restricted targeting in Personalized advertising policy. Google wrote, "Additionally, advertisers are not allowed to target users based on an interest in categories prohibited in Google’s ad network."

Google Ads 'Found On Site' Icon & More Pages Label On Sponsored Results
Google is testing a new label on its sponsored results on Google Ads named "Found on site." The label also has a text with a magnifying glass icon next to it. Next to the label is a site link that you can click on.

Google Ads Editor Version 2.14 Is Now Available
Google has released version 2.14 of the Google Ads Editor, which includes 10 new features.

Google Ads Data Strength Uplift Metric Doc
Google Ads has posted a new help document about the data strength uplift metric. This comes a month after Google posted another help document on Data Strength Best Practices. "The data strength uplift metric gives you a clearer picture of the value your first-party data setup delivers in Google Ads," Google wrote.

Bing Touts Two Methods To Turn Off AI In Search But It's Not A Search Setting
Microsoft announced, again, that there are ways to turn off AI features in Bing Search. We covered it twice before, but the first time we covered it, Bing had a search setting to disable AI Search (aka Copilot) from showing up in Bing. The second time, Bing removed that setting and asked people to download a browser extension or add -ai to the query to disable AI search features.
